hook: Twin-turbo V6 vs BMW-powered six. More kW for the Z, more Nm for the Supra. $21k apart.

stories.a: All-Nissan twin-turbo V6, more power, and a manual for no extra cost. Over $20k cheaper.
stories.b: BMW's B58 straight-six, more torque, 108 kg lighter and sips less fuel. Toyota claims 4.1 s to 100.
stories.take: The Z wins the price tag. The Supra wins the scales.

_sources: Carsales 'Nissan Z v Toyota GR Supra 2023 comparison' (30 Sep 2023): Z 298 kW, 475 Nm, 1633 kg auto, 9.8 L/100km auto, $75,800; GR Supra GTS 285 kW, 500 Nm, 1525 kg auto, 8.9 L/100km, $97,380, claimed 0-100 4.1 s auto; both manual or auto
CarExpert '2023 Nissan Z review': VR30DDTT 3.0 twin-turbo V6, 298 kW/475 Nm, Nissan quotes no 0-100 (so 0-100 left off the clash)
